name: zlib
release_kind: latest official stable release as of retrieval date
selection: Complete original release source tree; no upstream files modified

limitations: Only Linux x86-64 tested; macOS, ARM64, 32-bit and native Windows not tested
Current Mbed TLS CMake adapter requires POSIX pthreads; native Windows unsupported
Complete upstream test suites not run
WS/WSS data exchange and IPv6 connections not tested
CivetWeb 1.16 Mbed TLS backend does not implement TLS client API or server mTLS
curl_global_cleanup must follow shutdown of all other users of shared Mbed TLS/PSA

required_dependencies: standard C library; platform file APIs for gzip I/O
build_selection: Complete standard zlib static library; optional contrib libraries/examples/tests not built by adapter, originals retained
